# dislop

> Cutting AI slop is real productivity. Linter for AI Slop (7 packs, 53 rules, 65 patterns, 90 tools) for agents and people.

## Quick Start for Agents
- Shell (offline): `npx --yes dislop check <path> --pack auto --compact --json` (or `uvx dislop check <path> --compact --json`; exit `0`/`1`/`2`).
- Skill: `npx --yes skills add dislop-ai/dislop --skill dislop` (or read local `./references/*.md`).
- Remote MCP: `https://dislop.com/mcp` (`dislop_check`/`dislop_rules` 0 cr, no login; 30 cr/mo after sign-in).

## Start by task (~800-1,500 tokens each)
- [Review a brief](https://dislop.com/tasks/business-doc.md): AI artifacts and `business-brief` rules.
- [Check web UI or slides](https://dislop.com/tasks/web-and-deck.md): `deck-and-ui` rules and tokens.
- [Edit an essay](https://dislop.com/tasks/editorial-writing.md): `literary-essay` rules and contrasts.
- [Pre-release gate](https://dislop.com/tasks/pre-release-gate.md): Core `error` checks and CI diff gating.

## Browse by topic
- [Guides (EN & ZH)](https://dislop.com/en/guides/): 6 tutorials (ZH at `/guides/`).
- [Product Brief](https://dislop.com/methodology/product-brief.md): Positioning, users, and pitch.
- [Methodology](https://dislop.com/methodology/index.md): Plain writing guide and visual tokens.
- [Cases & Refs](https://dislop.com/cases/index.md): Contrasts and 31 design references.
- [Tools & Setup](https://dislop.com/tools/index.md): Skill, CLI, Plugin, and Cloud MCP.
- [Awesome Anti-Slop](https://dislop.com/awesome/index.md): 90 tools & papers (`/awesome/index.json`).
- [Roadmap](https://dislop.com/roadmap.md): Active tracks and collaboration.

## Machine index & discovery
- [MCP Server Card](https://dislop.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Auto-discovery for `/mcp` (10 tools).
- [Agent Skills Index](https://dislop.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): `SKILL.md` and card sha256 digests.
- [JSON Catalog](https://dislop.com/catalog.json): `dislop.catalog/1` manifest with sha256 and tokens.
- [Agent Skill](https://dislop.com/tools/skill.md): Mirror of `skills/dislop/SKILL.md` (`v0.8.1`).
- [Cloud MCP & API](https://dislop.com/tools/mcp-sdk-api.md): Remote MCP tools, OAuth 2.1, HTTP API.
- [Rule Packs](https://dislop.com/packs/core.md): 7 packs & 53 `/rules/<id>.md` cards.
- [Single-Fetch Bundle](https://dislop.com/llms-full.txt): All 53 rules without fixtures.
- [Privacy](https://dislop.com/privacy.md): Offline local boundaries and Cloud MCP policy.
